title: Sordland/Turn02/SnO_SecurityOverview
description:
Iosef Lancea and Valken Kruger give you a Defense Briefing talking about the Armed Forces of Sordland and each branch in detail. They then expand on the possible external threats of Rumburg and maybe even Valgsland. 

Lileas Graf and Nia Morgna talk about the law, justice system and the interior ministry. Details about several branches tied to the Interior come up. The internal security situation becomes clear.

entries.speaker: START
entries.title: START

entries.speaker: INPUT
entries.title: input

entries.speaker: OUTPUT
entries.title: output

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two ministers left the room. We..."
entries.dialogueText: The two ministers left the room. We took a short break before continuing to the second part.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Gentlemen, thanks for coming to th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Gentlemen, thanks for coming to this significant gathering. Let's begin.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef made his way towards the tabl..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef made his way towards the table while the others stood by the door.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon invitation, Iosef Lancea along..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon invitation, Iosef Lancea along with three high-ranking officials from the Ministry of Defense, walked into the room. One of the men was none other than General Kruger, the Chief of the Armed Forces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was in his 70s, yet he had a bul..."
entries.dialogueText: He was in his 70s, yet he had a bulky body that was a result of his commando training. Not only was he the second-most-decorated officer in Sordland, he was also the longest serving.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Kruger stepped forward and..."
entries.dialogueText: General Kruger stepped forward and saluted. He had a strong jaw with sharp cheekbones. His tall stature, uniform and medals, combined with his deep and intense stare, made him look threatening.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“General Kruger.”"
entries.dialogueText: “General Kruger.”
entries.menuText: “General Kruger.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef tapped his foot impatiently...."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef tapped his foot impatiently. He seemed uneasy with the presence of another high-ranking officer in the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted him."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted him.
entries.menuText: Salute him.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Mr. President. It is an honor.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. It is an honor.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's begin.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's begin."
entries.menuText: "Let's begin."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Mr. President. The situation at th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. The situation at the western and northern borders towards Rumburg is very tense. We are observing deployments of divisions closer to our border.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The picture is becoming clearer. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “The picture is becoming clearer. The latest information from the Interior about the weapons caches and now there is an active military build-up close to our borders.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The entire situation was analysed..."
entries.dialogueText: “The entire situation was analysed by our General Staff and our prediction is a future territorial incursion by Rumburg.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We will not let you down, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will not let you down, Mr. President. The General Staff is composed of the smartest military individuals.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let them come, we will give them h..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let them come, we will give them hell.”
entries.menuText: “Let them come, we will give them hell.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“With all due respect, I think you..."
entries.dialogueText: “With all due respect, I think you are underestimating what we could face.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have complete trust in the Gener..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have complete trust in the General Staff.”
entries.menuText: “I have complete trust in the General Staff.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“I share your enthusiasm. We draw o..."
entries.dialogueText: “I share your enthusiasm. We draw our strength from the brave sons and daughters of Sordland but we wouldn't be able to stand against them right now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I think the threat is exaggerated...."
entries.dialogueText: “I think the threat is exaggerated.”
entries.menuText: “The threat is exaggerated.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Rumburg has been acting increasing..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg has been acting increasingly expansionist in the past decades and also interfered in Agnolia, but now they have turned their sights on us.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”This concerns me very much.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”This concerns me very much.“
entries.menuText: ”This concerns me very much.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”What is your current strategy?“"
entries.dialogueText: ”What is your current strategy?“
entries.menuText: ”What is your current strategy?“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I trust the capabilities of our ar..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I trust the capabilities of our armed forces to handle any threats.“
entries.menuText: ”I trust the capabilities of our armed forces to handle any threats.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I can assure you of our capabiliti..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can assure you of our capabilities, but we don't have unlimited resources.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Please, General.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Please, General.“
entries.menuText: ”Please, General.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”Mr. President, if I may?“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Mr. President, if I may?“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We are observing these areas activ..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are observing these areas actively. Our contingency plans are ready.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Patrolling close to the borders wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Patrolling close to the borders with our border force and keeping army reserve divisions near.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: GameCondition.Turn02_SnO_SecurityOverview = true

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“I require an increase in the milit..."
entries.dialogueText: “I require an increase in the military budget to enlist more soldiers. Only then, we can stand strong against our enemies. The enlarged armed forces will hold them at bay.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Valken is right. We do need an inc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valken is right. We do need an increase in the military budget. Although we don't see eye to eye on exactly how to spend the budget, that much we agree on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Go on.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Go on.“
entries.menuText: ”Go on.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's move on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's move on.”
entries.menuText: “Let's move on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Which two crime families?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Which two crime families?”
entries.menuText: “Which two crime families?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I opened the door. Lucian, Nia and..."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the door. Lucian, Nia and Lileas rose from their seats.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“These ill-behaved thugs make our a..."
entries.dialogueText: “These ill-behaved thugs make our administration look weak. They're also disrupting the peace in those cities, meaning other issues like emigration."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today's security briefing was arran..."
entries.dialogueText: Today's security briefing was arranged in two parts, starting with internal matters and moving on to external matters after a short break.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our highest internal threat comes..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our highest internal threat comes from the estimated 20000-strong Bludish Freedom Front led by the imprisoned Dewlen Arge. They are a banned political organization, now a militant force that is trying to incite racial violence.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They make a lot of noise but have..."
entries.dialogueText: “They make a lot of noise but have little substance. A barking dog doesn't bite.”
entries.menuText: “They make a lot of noise but have little substance. A barking dog doesn't bite.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are they supported by our Bludish..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are they supported by our Bludish citizens?”
entries.menuText: “Are they supported by our Bludish citizens?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are they cooperating with any Blud..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are they cooperating with any Bludish political organizations?”
entries.menuText: “Are they cooperating with any Bludish political organizations?”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“It may seem that way from the outs..."
entries.dialogueText: “It may seem that way from the outside, but police intelligence shows a real potential for them to become dangerous.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“To some extent. Luckily they could..."
entries.dialogueText: “To some extent. Luckily they couldn't attract a wide audience of Bluds. But they could potentially attract thousands if anti-Bludish sentiment spreads in Sordland again.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We expect that more have been smug..."
entries.dialogueText: “We expect that more have been smuggled in. A group of Bluds were caught with these guns at a checkpoint not far away.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“This is grave news, but we must be..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is grave news, but we must be careful not to stoke the fires of anti-Bludish sentiment.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“It is the gang violence that is th..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is the gang violence that is threatening the Nargis and Agnland regions. Two prominent organized crime families are at war, and the potential for bloodshed is real.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why can't we just arrest them?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why can't we just arrest them?”
entries.menuText: “Why can't we just arrest them?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't think mere gangs can pose..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think mere gangs can pose a threat to us.”
entries.menuText: “I don't think mere gangs can pose a threat to us.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“One is known as the Koranelli and..."
entries.dialogueText: “One is known as the Koranelli and the other as the Skinner Cartel. They used to be allies until a recent disagreement. Both are active in the cities of Narbel and Estord.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The primary reason is deception an..."
entries.dialogueText: “The primary reason is deception and corruption. They infiltrated several government offices and the police. That's how they can evade us.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are playing with fire. I want..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are playing with fire. I want them gone. For good.”
entries.menuText: “They are playing with fire. I want them gone. For good.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you for the updates, Mrs. Gr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the updates, Mrs. Graf, Mrs. Morgna.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for the overview.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the overview.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for the overview.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Have a good day.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Have a good day.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Until next time.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Until next time.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I have received news this morning..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have received news this morning that the investigation into the murder of Bernard Circas has concluded.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“After further investigation and te..."
entries.dialogueText: “After further investigation and testimonies, we have confirmed the motive and also the events leading up to the shooting.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please enlighten us. The more we k..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please enlighten us. The more we know, the better.”
entries.menuText: “Please enlighten us. The more we know, the better.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Great news. I am eager to hear abo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Great news. I am eager to hear about the details.”
entries.menuText: “Great news. I am eager to hear about the details.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The reports around the country ind..."
entries.dialogueText: “The reports around the country indicate that tensions are rising as we feared.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Political violence needs to stop n..."
entries.dialogueText: “Political violence needs to stop now.”
entries.menuText: “Political violence needs to stop.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He had it coming then.”"
entries.dialogueText: “He had it coming then.”
entries.menuText: “He had it coming then.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Mr. Rayne, we have done our due di..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Rayne, we have done our due diligence, and the funding; operatives and strategy all point to a coup plot.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Nearly three decades ago, they fun..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nearly three decades ago, they funded General Rikard and tried to establish a communist dictatorship in our country. If it was not for Colonel Soll, we would have seen the real crisis.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our country always had issues, thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our country always had issues, this is a part of our job.”
entries.menuText: “Our country always had issues, this is a part of our job.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“A few days prior, members of the R..."
entries.dialogueText: “A few days prior, members of the Red Youth initiated a violent attack on a Young Sords local leader in Jen. We believe the Young Sords then called for revenge, leading to the death of Mr. Circas.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Since he often spoke against the Y..."
entries.dialogueText: “Since he often spoke against the Young Sords and nationalist sentiments in the Assembly, he was a big target. Not to mention his radical communist views.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The Red Youth are clearly to blame..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Red Youth are clearly to blame since they triggered it.”
entries.menuText: “The Red Youth are clearly to blame since they triggered it.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Yes. We've kept it at bay for so l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. We've kept it at bay for so long, but it seems that there are now new triggers.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“It is unfortunate, but it was like..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is unfortunate, but it was likely that an incident would happen.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“They struck first, yes. It was obv..."
entries.dialogueText: “They struck first, yes. It was obvious that there would be a retaliation.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The investigation revealed a very..."
entries.dialogueText: “The investigation revealed a very troubling fact. The funding sources of the Red Youth have a clear link to United Contana.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a sip from her glass of wa..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a sip from her glass of water and continued.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I also don't want to jump to concl..."
entries.dialogueText: “I also don't want to jump to conclusions. We shouldn't create a crisis with them.”
entries.menuText: “I also don't want to jump to conclusions immediately. We shouldn't create a crisis with them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I trust Ms. Graf's judgement. Unit..."
entries.dialogueText: “I trust Ms. Graf's judgement. United Contana is clearly trying to expand its influence.”
entries.menuText: “I trust Ms. Graf's judgement. United Contana is clearly trying to expand its influence.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This is debatable. But yes, we kno..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is debatable. But yes, we know what more security and surveillance caused to this country under President Soll.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas handed over the report and p..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas handed over the report and pointed at a highlighted section in the document.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What does this mean?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What does this mean?”
entries.menuText: “What does this mean?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you absolutely sure?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you absolutely sure?”
entries.menuText: “Are you sure?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is proof that they are meddli..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is proof that they are meddling in our affairs.”
entries.menuText: “This is proof that they are meddling in our affairs.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“That the communist superpower is m..."
entries.dialogueText: “That the communist superpower is meddling in our affairs.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As we feared, the political atmosp..."
entries.dialogueText: “As we feared, the political atmosphere has worsened.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Yes, we have found the cash trail...."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, we have found the cash trail.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Exactly.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Several Red Youth members with tie..."
entries.dialogueText: “Several Red Youth members with ties to United Contana have been detained, and the information extracted from them points to a preparation for a communist uprising in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I went over the report in detail...."
entries.dialogueText: “I went over the report in detail. It would be wrong to jump to conclusions about a clear foreign interference yet. United Contana has humanitarian and cultural ties with many countries including Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It isn't unusual for the superpowe..."
entries.dialogueText: “It isn't unusual for the superpowers to influence other nations but I think this case is a little far-fetched. The left lacks popular support in Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our police chief Karl Greiser has..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our police chief Karl Greiser has linked the funding channel to the United Contana Consulate in Benfi.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“As we all know, the enemies of Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: “As we all know, the enemies of Sordland are many, but we also have threats inside the country.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“As the government we have all the..."
entries.dialogueText: “As the government we have all the power to deal with any threat that we face.”
entries.menuText: “As the government we have all the power to deal with any threat.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to remain vigilant as a pe..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to remain vigilant as a people and nation.”
entries.menuText: “We need to remain vigilant.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“If we give up essential freedoms t..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we give up essential freedoms to purchase temporary security, we deserve neither freedoms nor security.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Let's not forget that President So..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's not forget that President Soll, God bless him, brought stability after a long period of bloodshed and chaos. But moving on...”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This is worrying. Very worrying.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This is worrying. Very worrying.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Many suspected links exist between..."
entries.dialogueText: “Many suspected links exist between the Bludish Freedom Front and the Workers' Party of Bludia, but we don't have concrete proof yet.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It was expected that Rumburg would..."
entries.dialogueText: “It was expected that Rumburg would undermine us, but this is too far.”
entries.menuText: “It was expected that Rumburg would undermine us, but this is too far.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to keep level-headed with..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to keep level-headed with Rumburg. They are looking for reasons to take action.”
entries.menuText: “We need to keep level-headed with Rumburg. They are looking for reasons to take action.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I agree, the prospect of arming ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree, the prospect of arming our population against us is a step too far.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“They will play dirty while we play..."
entries.dialogueText: “They will play dirty while we play nice. It is a battle we will lose.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can't let anyone meddle with ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can't let anyone meddle with our internal stability.”
entries.menuText: “We can't let anyone meddle with our internal stability.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our security services are doing th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our security services are doing their best to prevent further attempts.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I have my concerns about Rumburg t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have my concerns about Rumburg too. We need strong allies to withstand such a superior power. They are our nemesis.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I arrived in front of the doors lea..."
entries.dialogueText: I arrived in front of the doors leading to the Situation Room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Minister of Interior, Lileas Gr..."
entries.dialogueText: The Minister of Interior, Lileas Graf and the Minister of Justice and Law, Nia Morgna would join us for the first part, the law enforcement briefing.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's begin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's begin.”
entries.menuText: “Let's begin.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please take your seats.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please take your seats.”
entries.menuText: “Please take your seats.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded at Lucian and sat down."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded at Lucian and sat down.
entries.menuText: Nod at Lucian.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the room sat down excep..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the room sat down except for Lucian. He put on his glasses and went through the documents in front of him. Shortly after, he raised his head to address the attendees.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I am assuming everyone has already..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am assuming everyone has already been over the agenda. We all have busy schedules. So without further ado, I will jump into our first topic.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. President. Ladies. We will kic..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Ladies. We will kick off today's meeting with the internal security briefing.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas Graf cleared her throat."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas Graf cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can we make any direct correlation..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can we make any direct correlations between the BFF and Rumburg?”
entries.menuText: “Can we make any direct correlations between the BFF and Rumburg?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are insignificant. Not worth..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are insignificant. Not worth our attention.”
entries.menuText: “They are insignificant. Not worth our attention.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I would be careful with underestim..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would be careful with underestimating them, sir. They might cause legitimate unrest if this goes on.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“While I agree it would make Sordla..."
entries.dialogueText: “While I agree it would make Sordland a better place, it will not be easy.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Well, this concludes the topics fo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, this concludes the topics for the internal portion.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the second part the Minister of..."
entries.dialogueText: For the second part the Minister of Defense, Iosef Lancea would join with a few high-ranking officials including the Chief of the Armed Forces Valken Kruger.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled at the gesture and bowed..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled at the gesture and bowed his head in respect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef and Valken took their seats a..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef and Valken took their seats at the table while the rest of the officers stood by the door.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Do not forget that during the elec..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do not forget that during the election you promised to focus on the military. I expect that word to be kept for the defense of our nation.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“During the election you said nothi..."
entries.dialogueText: “During the election you said nothing about focusing on our military. I ask you to reconsider and to increase the military budget. The future and safety of Sordland is in your hands.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“That is an understatement. Times a..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is an understatement. Times are changing and war is coming, Mr. President, whether we like it or not. We must be prepared.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am a man of my word, Iosef.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am a man of my word, Iosef.”
entries.menuText: “I am a man of my word, Iosef.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“As you said before, times change,..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you said before, times change, Iosef. We will see.”
entries.menuText: “As you said times change, Iosef. We will see.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Of course you are and that is why..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course you are and that is why I follow you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef's face instantly soured."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef's face instantly soured.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“As you said before, times change,..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you said before, times change, Iosef. We will see.”
entries.menuText: “As you said times change, Iosef. We will see.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Maybe you are right. Defense of ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe you are right. Defense of our nation is more important.”
entries.menuText: “Maybe you are right. Defense of our nation is more important.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am a man of my word, Iosef.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am a man of my word, Iosef.”
entries.menuText: “I am a man of my word, Iosef.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A smile brought a glimmer of hope o..."
entries.dialogueText: A smile brought a glimmer of hope on Iosef's face.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“That is a valuable trait, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is a valuable trait, Mr. President. However, it will not help when the enemy armies are invading our cities.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I knew you would understand, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew you would understand, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Valken, we should go to the Minist..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valken, we should go to the Ministry and get further updates from our branches.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They saluted and left the room."
entries.dialogueText: They saluted and left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumburg had decided to close their..."
entries.dialogueText: Rumburg had decided to close their consulate in Lachaven.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "His handshake was firm, strong and..."
entries.dialogueText: His handshake was firm, strong and confident.
entries.menuText: Shake his hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone fell silent when a soldier..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone fell silent when a soldier entered the room and let Iosef Lancea know that a call had come through from the Ministry.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I shall be honest with you. With o..."
entries.dialogueText: “I shall be honest with you. With our current capabilities, we may not be able to prevent the further arming of separatists while maintaining order in Bergia, Nargis and Agnland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“True but I am not fully convinced..."
entries.dialogueText: “True but I am not fully convinced that would be the right choice.”
entries.menuText: “True but I am not fully convinced that would be the right choice.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“These threats seem more direct tha..."
entries.dialogueText: “These threats seem more direct than a few bribes.”
entries.menuText: “These threats seem more direct than a few bribes.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will stick to that promise, esp..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will stick to that promise, especially in light of all this information.”
entries.menuText: “We will stick to that promise, especially in light of all this information.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas Graf sighed deeply."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas Graf sighed deeply.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“You promised to increase Sordland'..."
entries.dialogueText: “You promised to increase Sordland's security and law enforcement budget. You must keep this promise.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“If the law enforcement budget isn'..."
entries.dialogueText: “If the law enforcement budget isn't increased, I can't be fully responsible for what happens. Our police units are spread thin as is.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You will do your job whatever happ..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will do your job whatever happens. Don't come to me with excuses.”
entries.menuText: “You will do your job whatever happens. Don't come to me with excuses.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“In light of this information, I mi..."
entries.dialogueText: “In light of this information, I might increase the law enforcement budget.”
entries.menuText: “In light of this information, I might increase the law enforcement budget.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will rid our country from separ..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will rid our country from separatists and violent thugs if you support us.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“If threats from separatists and vi..."
entries.dialogueText: “If threats from separatists and violent thugs aren't cause for serious concern on your end, I don't know what will be.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will rid our country from separ..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will rid our country from separatists and violent thugs if you do so.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“My job is to keep you fully inform..."
entries.dialogueText: “My job is to keep you fully informed, and this is the reality. My experience and expertise in keeping our country safe from violent thugs can only go so far."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I wish you would stop using the wo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wish you would stop using the word 'thugs', Lileas. The real problem is corruption, which is fuelling the gang violence and is very likely the reason why these weapons were smuggled in. A higher budget could help us end that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Valid points. Corruption is the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valid points. Corruption is the root of all evil, after all.”
entries.menuText: “Valid points. Corruption is the root of all evil, after all.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“They are, and they need all the at..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are, and they need all the attention they can get from our administration.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We can look into corruption once t..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can look into corruption once the weapons have been found and the gangs have been beaten.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas pointed to page three in the..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas pointed to page three in the report.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our intelligence intercepted two c..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our intelligence intercepted two crates filled with weapons close to the Rumburg border. They were filled with military-grade KA-74s.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Rumburg has been acting aggressive..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg has been acting aggressively in the region for a long time. I am not surprised that they would attempt to weaponize the Bludish people against us.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I am doing my best, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “I am doing my best, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lileas, I trust that you can handl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lileas, I trust that you can handle them.”
entries.menuText: “Lileas, I trust that you can handle them.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“We are, but it needs all the atten..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are, but it needs all the attention it can get from our administration.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your Ministry must tackle the issu..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your Ministry must tackle the issue with persistence, Ms. Morgna.”
entries.menuText: “Your Ministry must tackle the issue with persistence Ms. Morgna.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Just like previous administrations..."
entries.dialogueText: “Just like previous administrations, kicking the can down the road... This is what's destroying our institutions.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It seems like they want to increas..."
entries.dialogueText: “It seems like they want to increase the pressure both externally and internally.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Our forces would crumble under a d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our forces would crumble under a decrease and Rumburg would be much more compelled to exploit our weakness.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“The only way we can guarantee the..."
entries.dialogueText: “The only way we can guarantee the national survival is through a more capable military force against Rumburg.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Our country hasn't fallen to any i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our country hasn't fallen to any invading force for two-hundred years, you cannot let it happen, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We should find regional allies lik..."
entries.dialogueText: “We should find regional allies like Valgsland or Lespia to deter Rumburg. There are several options on the table.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Rumburg wouldn't attack any nation..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg wouldn't attack any nation allied with any superpower.”
entries.menuText: “Rumburg wouldn't attack any nation allied with any superpower.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sordland must stand on its own two..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sordland must stand on its own two feet and be able to defend itself.”
entries.menuText: “Sordland must stand on its own two feet and be able to defend itself.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Of the same mind, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of the same mind, sir.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We stand strong as we've always do..."
entries.dialogueText: “We stand strong as we've always done.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“We have no true friends outside th..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have no true friends outside these borders.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They could be considered, but why..."
entries.dialogueText: “They could be considered, but why pander to others when we can solve these issues ourselves?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“These options should be considered..."
entries.dialogueText: “These options should be considered.”
entries.menuText: “These options should be considered.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Yes, but what is difference betwee..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, but what is difference between losing your independence to one or the other?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“One shudders at the sacrifices the..."
entries.dialogueText: “One shudders at the sacrifices they would require us to make.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Understood. Raising military readi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Understood. Raising military readiness is the first call of action. If there is truly an extraordinary attempt, we will relay it to you immediately and wait for further orders, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your service is appreciated, gentl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your service is appreciated, gentlemen.”
entries.menuText: “Your service is appreciated, gentlemen.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Iosef, welcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "Iosef, welcome."
entries.menuText: "Iosef, welcome."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""I brought General Kruger with me d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I brought General Kruger with me due to the escalation on our borders."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Excuse me, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Excuse me, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef left the room to answer."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef left the room to answer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes later he entered the..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes later he entered the room again. His expression had changed.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Mr. President. There has been Rumb..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. There has been Rumburgian military activity close to the Narbel border. I just spoke with the local commander.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Thank you, Mr. President. You shal..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President. You shall be updated if the situation escalates.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go and show them the might of the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Go and show them the might of the Sordish Armed Forces.”
entries.menuText: “Go and show them the might of the Sordish Armed Forces.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We will. You can be sure of that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will. You can be sure of that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Make sure they know we are observa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Make sure they know we are observant and ready.”
entries.menuText: “Make sure they know we are observant and ready.”

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“'Always watching, always ready' is..."
entries.dialogueText: “'Always watching, always ready' is our motto, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumburg was already testing us and..."
entries.dialogueText: Rumburg was already testing us and the reports from the Interior indicate interference inside our borders. Communists, Nationalists, Bludish rebels, Rumburg expansionism? What was next?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sordland had always been a key piec..."
entries.dialogueText: Sordland had always been a key piece in the chessboard of the global rivalry between Arcasia and United Contana. But in the recent years, there was no such aggression from Rumburg. Not at these levels at least.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "“Hail Sordland!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hail Sordland!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All it takes is one tiny spark to s..."
entries.dialogueText: All it takes is one tiny spark to start the flames of war.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The phone rang."
entries.dialogueText: The phone rang.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“What is the status on the Bernard..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is the status on the Bernard Circas investigation?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Radical? Sordland just lost a grea..."
entries.dialogueText: “Radical? Sordland just lost a great writer. For what?”
entries.menuText: “Radical? Sordland just lost a great writer. For what?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Remain calm. Make sure not to esca..."
entries.dialogueText: “Remain calm. Make sure not to escalate things further. Nobody wants a war.”
entries.menuText: “Remain calm. Make sure not to escalate things further. Nobody wants a war.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We will exercise utmost caution, M..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will exercise utmost caution, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Hail!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hail!”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Not yet but we have suspects that..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not yet but we have suspects that indicate such a correlation.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“These gangs exist because corrupti..."
entries.dialogueText: “These gangs exist because corruption is so common in our country. They buy our police officers and slip by checkpoints.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“These gangs exist because corrupti..."
entries.dialogueText: “These gangs exist because corruption is so common in our country. They buy our police officers and slip by checkpoints.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Unfortunately, Governor Bron is di..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, Governor Bron is directly causing the tensions to increase with his increasingly anti-Bludish stance."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The governor of Bergia, Phelix Bro..."
entries.dialogueText: "The governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron, is already taking the necessary measures to counter the threat."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""He is misusing the powers given to..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is misusing the powers given to him by Tarquin Soll. The insane authority of the governor is surely a root cause."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I must remind you Governor Bron is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must remind you Governor Bron is directly responsible for the arrest of Dewlen Arge, the previous leader of the BFF."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It's true that his methods can be..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true that his methods can be extreme at times, but it was his policies that kept the region peaceful over the last decade."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It would be very difficult to revo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be very difficult to revoke the special status of Bergia under the current circumstances, Ms. Morgna. The presidents no longer have the authority Tarquin Soll enjoyed."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""For now, yes. But with enough just..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now, yes. But with enough justification for it, it would be possible. Anyway... We will be discussing this at a later time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The discrimination Bergia suffers..."
entries.dialogueText: "The discrimination Bergia suffers is maddening. We should find a way to revoke the 'special' status of Bergia one way or another."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd rather not disturb the status..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather not disturb the status quo while we're facing all these threats."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Governor Bron and his special powe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Governor Bron and his special powers deserve credit for the current peace in the region."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I will do my best, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will do my best, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I agree. We shouldn't rush anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. We shouldn't rush anything on such a divisive topic."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The fact that he is an important U..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that he is an important USP member also makes him a possible ally."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia gestured at Lileas."
entries.dialogueText: Nia gestured at Lileas.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""What is the second most important..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is the second most important threat?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell me more about the Special Zon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about the Special Zone."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. I'd like to hear more.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. I'd like to hear more."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Bergia has always been the region..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bergia has always been the region of chaos and trouble. We must be careful."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""As you know, Bergia was given a sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, Bergia was given a special status by Tarquin Soll after the full-scale uprising by the BFF against the Sordish government in '35."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Those couple years were disastrous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those couple years were disastrous for Bergia. Dewlen Arge and the BFF declared war on us, openly attacked our people and occupied entire cities."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It was a massive uprising but I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a massive uprising but I'd like to point out the longest time they were in control of a city was two weeks. I wouldn't call that an occupation."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Despite the arrest of Dewlen Arge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the arrest of Dewlen Arge in '44 and the BFF ceasing its activities, the special status of the region were never revoked."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Today, the Special Zone of Bergia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, the Special Zone of Bergia gives the governor insane amounts of authority. He was in trouble with the law before for not following the central government's authority."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Unfortunately, Bergia also has its..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, Bergia also has its own police forces directly commanded by Governor Bron. They are not part of my ministry and only cooperate when they are forced to do so. This is a problem."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Even though our forces have the au..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even though our forces have the authority to serve in Bergia, the Special Zone leaves the security of Bergia mostly in the hands of the governor. That leaves my hands tied."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must reverse this situation. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must reverse this situation. It is absurd that the Ministry of Interior doesn't have full control over Bergia's security."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I agree. I have some ideas about i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. I have some ideas about it already. But we can talk about that at a later time."
